commands.summary: Listed the file tree of each app at its pinned commit.
Read Dockerfiles, configs, manifests and entrypoints at the pinned commits; a few probes for missing paths returned 404 and were not used.
YAML parse, expectedFactsSchema parse, id/repo/commit equal to slice, every fact has citations, every cited path exists in the pinned tree: 0 failures.

notes: Source only. No Deployz analysis was run and no Deployz result was read.

Convention: postgres/redis are true only when the default or required configuration uses them. SQLite or H2 defaults give postgres false even if PostgreSQL is an optional backend (anything-llm, lobsters, traccar, woodpecker, lldap).

Convention: migration is set only when a migration command exists in an entrypoint, release script, compose command or install step. It is omitted when migrations run implicitly in-process (lobsters, traccar, btcpayserver, woodpecker, lldap). storage is omitted for all apps (no S3 requirement).

Convention: dockerfilePath is relative to the repository root. It is omitted when the repo has no usable application Dockerfile (lobsters has only Dockerfile.dev, akaunting has none, traccar Dockerfiles need a release zip that is not in the repo).
repo-571 firezone: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Dockerfile needs the APPLICATION_NAME build arg, and the listener port has no default (env only). Port left unset. Health /readyz from Portal.Health plug.

repo-572 anything-llm: NOT_COMPATIBLE. SQLite datasource and local storage dir; PostgreSQL needs a schema edit. SQLite is not in the UNSUPPORTED_FAMILIES names I was allowed to use, so unsupported is not set.

repo-573 mem0 server: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. Dockerfile CMD does not run alembic (only the compose command does); second database mem0_app needed; no dedicated health route, so /auth/setup-status (used by the Makefile) is the health path.

repo-574 lobsters: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Production database.yml.sample is SQLite only (four database files) and storage is on local disk; no production Dockerfile. worker true from Procfile.dev job: bin/jobs. SQLite name not available for unsupported.

repo-575 traccar: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Dockerfiles copy a prebuilt release zip; GPS device TCP ports 5000-5500; default embedded H2 (unsupported other-database, the map name for h2). jedis is optional so redis false.

repo-576 btcpayserver: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Needs NBXplorer plus a Bitcoin node (external long-running services) and a /datadir volume. Port left unset because the default Kestrel port was not found in source. Postgres is required (SQLite and MySQL rejected). Auto-migration is in-process, so migration is omitted.

repo-577 woodpecker: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Server Dockerfile copies a prebuilt dist binary; default sqlite3; separate agent service with Docker socket and gRPC 9000. Worker false because the agent is a separate image.

repo-578 lldap: NOT_COMPATIBLE. Core service is LDAP on TCP 3890, /data config and SQLite default. Port 17170 is the web UI. No HTTP health route found, so healthPath is omitted (healthcheck is an LDAP check).

repo-579 akaunting: NOT_COMPATIBLE. No Dockerfile, default DB_CONNECTION mysql (unsupported mysql), web installer writes .env. Laravel also supports pgsql, so this is a judgment call that could be NEEDS_CONFIGURATION if a reviewer prefers it.

repo-580 keeper.sh: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. docker/services/Dockerfile bundles web, api, cron and worker under s6 with Postgres and Redis. Browser calls the API on port 3001, so a second public route needs configuration. A standalone Dockerfile that bundles Postgres and Redis also exists; the services Dockerfile was chosen.
